topic.title: A question about the test set's composition rather than the metric: the assumption every class-3 estimate is linear in
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hi,

Community discussion has estimated the split of test molecules between

  • (a) present in common structure databases,
  • (b) present in the training spectra,
  • and (c) absent from both, but I cannot find an official figure.

Are you able to say roughly what fraction of the test molecules are not present in public structure databases? Even an order of magnitude would help us decide whether a de novo generation stage is worth building.

Thanks.

comments.content: We will not provide the breakdown of the test set, but our hope is that there are enough novel structures to make it worth working on them.
